evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official GOV.UK Liverpool City Region Freeport tax-site page lists Parkside as one of three tax-site maps and states that the Liverpool City Region Freeport tax sites were designated with effect from 22 March 2022. The Designation of Freeport Tax Sites (Liverpool City Region Freeport) Regulations 2022 designate the areas shown edged and hatched in red on the map entitled "Parkside East and West Tax Site", dated 3 December 2021, with effect from 22 March 2022.
